revisions.text: I'm just a spirit job, patiently waiting, sitting here with no cares in the world, just waiting, perfectly content, happy in my lot in life, comfortably knowing that I haven't been forgotten.
I'm just a spirit jar patiently waiting.  Sitting here with no cares in the world.  Just.  Waiting.   Perfectly content.  Happy in my lot in life, comfortably knowing that I haven't been forgotten.
